newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - Gilts to shoot for 115-24 if 115-05 goes.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Gilts to shoot for 115-24 if 115-05 goes.

text.p: September gilt futures on LIFFE will aim for trendline resistance around 115-24 on Wednesday if they successfully penetrate the contract high at 115-05 first, technical analysts said.
"The Bonds obviously went up quite a lot so I think it's going to carry over into the gilts," Gerry Celaya, senior technical analyst at American Express Bank in London said.
"I wouldn't be surprised if we didn't open up strongly above 115-00 towards 115-05," he said.
U.S. Treasuries rallied on Tuesday after testimony from Federal Reserve Chairman Alan Greenspan.
Greenspan said the Fed would raise U.S. interest rates if needed to head off inflation but suggested it might not happen soon.
Celaya said the trendline was drawn off February and May highs on continuation charts. Above there, the psychological level of 116-00 would feature, he said.
"It looks like it's going to be a bull flag breakout," he said.
He said if the contract drifted back towards 115-05 on the down side it would look to support at 114-23, the high from Monday.
Below there, the low from Tuesday at 114-15 would act as a buffer as well as Monday's 114-11 low, Celaya said. Heavy congestion surfaces at 114-00 to 113-30 and a rising trendline at 113-26.
Gilts were quoted at 115-11 at 0721 GMT, up 12/32 from Tuesday's pit settlement.

Technical analysts at Chase in London said Elliott Wave count suggested a clear break of 115-05, implying a sharp acceleration to 116-00 and on to 117-25 and 121-01 eventually. Shorter term, it was important to hold the Monday's 114-11 low.
December short sterling futures were up 0.03 at 92.63.
